description: Asks the SOP assistant a question about company policies and procedures, as the handbook's Ask Sergio chat does, and returns one answer with a Sources section linking the SOPs it used. It answers only from the business's active SOPs and says so when they do not cover the question. Pass up to 10 earlier turns in history (role user or assistant, with the text) for a follow-up. Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying; a repeat returns the same answer without asking the model again.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.
